rules: Do not infer an automation scope from its number
Do not create commands, schedules, repositories or live targets until the original scope is verified
A discovered repository or account is not an approved target
Recovery is read-only until a dedicated branch and permission contract are confirmed

automations.freezeReason: Current production main and ADG-MONITOR-V4 are authoritative; older Automation 2 repairs are superseded where they conflict
